extracted.name: Fried Beef Pies
extracted.description: This Fried Beef Pie is crispy, golden, and filled with juicy, flavorful beef. The thin, flaky crust locks in the rich, savory filling, making every bite delicious. Perfect as a hearty snack or a satisfying meal, it’s best enjoyed fresh off the pan! Enjoy!
instruction_lines: Make the Dough: • In a bowl, mix flour and salt. Gradually add warm water, knead until smooth. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Prepare the Filling: • In a food processor, combine ground beef, salt, black pepper, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, onions, and scallions. Pulse until well blended and finely chopped.

Assembly: • Divide rested dough into 10 pieces, roll into balls, and brush with oil. Rest for 40 minutes. • Flatten each dough ball into a disc. Place a spoonful of the blended filling in the center. Gather edges to seal tightly.
Cooking: • Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Place pies seam-side down. Cook until golden brown and cooked through, about 1-2 minutes per side.
Served best when warm and fresh!
